title: [bug] oscore C module LOG name mismatch: REGISTER(coap_oscore) vs DECLARE(oscore) - oscore test apps fail to link on v4.1.0
description: Found while verifying the 2z8e helper port (build/oscore native_sim v4.1.0): link fails with undefined log_const_oscore from oscore_ctx.c/oscore_protect.c/oscore_replay.c. Cause: lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/coap_oscore.c:23 does LOG_MODULE_REGISTER(coap_oscore, ...) while oscore_ctx.c:23, oscore_protect.c:22 and oscore_replay.c:17 do LOG_MODULE_DECLARE(oscore, ...) - the declared module name 'oscore' is never registered anywhere, so on v4.1.0's logging (per-name symbols) the reference dangles. Likely linked fine on older pins with different log symbol generation. Fix: one token - make the registration LOG_MODULE_REGISTER(oscore, CONFIG_LICHEN_OSCORE_LOG_LEVEL) (majority DECLARE wins, 3 files vs 1). Blocks runtime testing of every oscore test app on v4.1.0 (lichen/tests/oscore, oscore_persist, oscore_schc_roundtrip, coap_oscore_fallback, coap_keys). Verification: build/oscore then links and the oscore tests run.
